name: yaps-memory
description: Use a private local Markdown memory store across Codex chats. Search remembered facts and notes, cite sources, capture durable context, and update your Yaps vault safely.

interface.shortDescription: Private local Markdown memory across Codex chats.
interface.longDescription: Give Codex durable, cross-chat memory through your private local Markdown Yaps vault. Search remembered facts, notes, decisions, meetings, ideas, resources, and dictation history; retrieve focused evidence with citations; capture new context; and make permission-controlled, conflict-safe edits through Yaps' local MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yaps Memory. Check my connection, explain privacy and permissions, then guide me through my first useful action.
Help me capture a new memory in Yaps. Ask what I want to remember and where it belongs.
Summarize my five most recently updated Yaps notes and cite each note's title and path.
